# Documentation fonts

Both font families are bundled under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Their licenses
are in `public-sans-OFL.txt` and `jetbrains-mono-OFL.txt`.

## Public Sans

Variable WOFF2 files from the official Google Fonts distribution, downloaded on 2026-11-04.
Normal and italic styles cover weights 100–900 and Latin, extended Latin, and Vietnamese.
Files are served locally by Sphinx. No third-party font requests are needed at build or reading time.

- [Stylesheet source](https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Public+Sans:ital,wght@0,100..900;1,100..900&display=swap)
- [License source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/publicsans/OFL.txt)
- [Font project](https://github.com/uswds/public-sans)

## JetBrains Mono

Variable WOFF2 files from the official Google Fonts distribution, downloaded on 2026-11-04.
Normal and italic styles cover weights 100–800 and Latin, extended Latin, Greek,
Cyrillic, extended Cyrillic, and Vietnamese. Files are served locally by Sphinx.

- [Stylesheet source](https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:ital,wght@0,100..800;1,100..800&display=swap)
- [License source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/jetbrainsmono/OFL.txt)
- [Font project](https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono)
